messages.subject: Thank you, Veloria Bay Foundation
messages.body:
Dear Veloria Bay Foundation,

Thank you for your $350,000 gift on April 15, 2025. Gifts like yours are how Miami's community foundation shows up for this city.

From The Miami Foundation's work: Press Forward South Florida, an initiative fueled in part by The Miami Foundation, announced grants to more than a dozen newsrooms and partnerships serving Broward, Miami-Dade and Monroe counties.

A story we're proud of: The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide pro bono legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.
Where gifts go: The Miami Foundation committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.
How the Foundation is doing: The September newsletter reported that Give Miami Day had become the largest single-city giving day in the nation, with 60,000+ donors raising over $40 million for 1,000+ local nonprofits last year.

There's no ask in this note. We simply wanted you to know your support matters.

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation philanthropy team

re_engage:email.subject: Gates Foundation, here's what we did this year
re_engage:email.body:
Dear Gates Foundation,

Thank you for your partnership with The Miami Foundation. We've missed hearing from you, and we wanted to share an update.

From The Miami Foundation's work: Press Forward South Florida, an initiative fueled in part by The Miami Foundation, announced grants to more than a dozen newsrooms and partnerships serving Broward, Miami-Dade and Monroe counties.

A story we're proud of: The Miami Foundation partnered with McDermott Will & Schulte to provide pro bono legal counsel to 17 Miami nonprofits, delivering 398 hours of service valued at more than $500,000.
Where gifts go: The Miami Foundation committed $100,000 to support Spanish-language coverage through elTOQUE and City of Miami coverage through The Florida Trib in partnership with the Coconut Grove Spotlight.
How the Foundation is doing: The September newsletter reported that Give Miami Day had become the largest single-city giving day in the nation, with 60,000+ donors raising over $40 million for 1,000+ local nonprofits last year.

We'd love to catch up. Could we set up a short call or coffee with our philanthropy team about your year-end giving?

With gratitude,
The Miami Foundation philanthropy team
